title: Prefix Sum: Pattern recognition and reusable templates

scenes.title: Mental model
bullets: Precompute cumulative totals so any range aggregate becomes a difference of two prefix states.

scenes.title: State contract
bullets: prefix[i] represents exactly the first i elements, making range [l, r) equal prefix[r] - prefix[l].

scenes.title: Implementation sequence
bullets: combine with a frequency map for target subarrays
promote numeric type when sums grow

scenes.title: Worked reasoning
bullets: A subarray ending at current prefix P sums to k for every earlier prefix P-k.

scenes.title: Complexity proof
bullets: O(n) preprocessing and O(1) range queries, or O(n) for target-subarray counting with a map.
Call out hidden copies or sorts

scenes.title: Failure modes
bullets: using it for frequently updated arrays without a Fenwick tree
